independence_evidence: Self-published zine from a one-person London creative studio, distributed by Public Knowledge Books; no corporate owner (https://fatboyzine.com/about/).
qualifies_reason: Independent London food zine whose sixth issue went on sale in September 2025.
what_it_is: FatBoy Zine is a London-made, yearly print zine about Asian food and identity. Each issue takes a theme or place (Filipino food, Hong Kong, Taiwan, the diaspora, multi-heritage cooking) and combines interviews with chefs and artists, commissioned writing and illustration, and a set of recipes. It is for readers interested in food culture, migration and graphic design-led small publishing.
